What AI Drinks

39% of the new AI campuses sit where water is already scarce

Hover a point for details. Click the legend to show or hide a layer.

Shaded areas are river basins where water is already under pressure, from WRI Aqueduct 4.0: the share of the available supply withdrawn each year by farms, industry and homes. Medium to high is 20 to 40%, high is 40 to 80%, extremely high is over 80%. Dots and circles are the same data centers and AI campuses as in Where AI Gets Built.
